TaskDescription: Raw iEEG during single-pulse electrical stimulation (before/after continuous stimulation, per the release)
ElectricalStimulationParameters: single-pulse stimulation; amplitude not stated in file name; site lateral OFC (README: no location in the file name = lateral OFC) (from source file name EC139_rawData_SPS.mat). Protocol (Rao et al. 2018, STAR Methods): bipolar single-pulse stimulation (SPS) with the Nicolet Cortical Stimulator (Natus Medical), 10 mA, 1 Hz, 500 us pulse width, 20 s duration, administered in some subjects before and after continuous OFC stimulation.
ElectrodeManufacturer: AdTech (Racine, WI) or Integra (Plainsboro, NJ); the manufacturer per subject is not stated (Rao et al. 2018, STAR Methods)
iEEGPlacementScheme: Clinically guided implant for seizure localization (Rao et al. 2018). Table S1: hemisphere left; subdural grids/strips with depth electrodes; coverage LFC, AOF, LTC, STC, DC, INS, AMY, HIP (LFC lateral frontal, AOF/POF anterior/posterior orbitofrontal, LTC lateral temporal, STC subtemporal, DC dorsal cingulate, SCC subgenual cingulate, INS insula, AMY amygdala, HIP hippocampus).
